facts.text: Snow left Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) and Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) 7 to 16 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: July 1 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 27 (2025)

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: July 30 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: 17.7 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 85.8 in (2023), 36.1 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: 7.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 54.4 in (2023), 16.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: 44.6 in on May 5; earlier seasons: 118.4 in (2023), 61.3 in (2024), 53.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 11 and July 11, carried from the melt-out dates at 4 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 941 ft below the pass; points to May 7 to July 3

evidence.name: Paradise Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 13, 2,491 ft below the pass; points to May 16 to August 5

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 741 ft below the pass; points to April 27 to June 20

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 541 ft below the pass; points to May 29 to July 19
